tasteDNA.name: Authority comes from weight, not size
tasteDNA.trigger: Executive money queue; 7 columns must fit without per-row scrolling
tasteDNA.decision: 9-12px type at weights 700-900 with letterspaced uppercase micro-labels; only the MD's two scan targets (waiting counter, amounts) get size or darkness
tasteDNA.reason: Density buys triage speed; heavy weight preserves scannability at small sizes. 14px comfortable type was the rejected alternative
tasteDNA.evidence: text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] table headers; 30px font-black counter (md-approvals-client.tsx:495-499,836)

tasteDNA.name: One filled surface per screen
tasteDNA.trigger: All-white card pages decay accent color into decoration
tasteDNA.decision: Exactly one gradient-filled surface (the table header banner, documented in a code comment); accent elsewhere only as text, rings, tints <=12%, active tab
tasteDNA.reason: The banner anchors where work starts; rupee amounts stay the darkest ink on the page
tasteDNA.evidence: HEADER_BANNER gradient (line 104) vs CARD 'bg-white ... shadow-xs' (line 108); one leak: bulk bar's hardcoded rgba(5,91,101,0.35) shadow

tasteDNA.name: State is flat color - never motion, never elevation
tasteDNA.trigger: Bulk-selection tables invite card-lift, scale and checkbox theatrics
tasteDNA.decision: Selection = 5px left accent + 12% tint with the gutter reserved even when unselected; hover = flat slate-50; non-actionable rows get no affordance at all
tasteDNA.reason: Where a click approves money, layout must be still under the pointer; the cursor, not the stage column, answers 'can I act on this?'
tasteDNA.evidence: borderLeft 5px solid transparent|primary inline (lines 879-882); role/tabIndex/hover gated on row.awaitingMd (867-887)

tasteDNA.name: Semantic color is reserved for verdicts
tasteDNA.trigger: Three verdict actions on every row of a monochrome page
tasteDNA.decision: Rose/amber/emerald appear only on verdict surfaces; approve wears the brand primary, not green; chrome stays slate + primary
tasteDNA.reason: When color always means a decision or its consequence, peripheral rose IS the alert; green-for-approve was rejected so the commonest action reads neutral
tasteDNA.evidence: approve bg-primary (803); reject rose-200/700 (812); days>=7 badge slate->amber (908-915); failure panel rose (636)
